name: contract-preview-folder-audit
goal: Accept only the generated __harness route preview folder while retaining ordinary folder-name rejections

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: The generated app CLI case reaches 31 screenshot cases but audit rejects its generated __harness routes. Keep private preview URLs and reject that reserved name outside src/routes.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing route-folder matrix covers framework parameter forms but omits generated preview folders and their non-route rejection. Extend that same matrix and preserve its title and case count.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Laptop record 02a8deab0b00 at e370ec02e3 fails the existing route-folder matrix: __harness inside routes is incorrectly rejected, while all non-route controls stay rejected.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Commit d26e0fdbea permits the reserved preview segment only beneath src/routes. Ordinary reserved folders remain rejected; the checkpoint tests are unchanged.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Matched laptop record 12986a17b841 passes the existing route-folder case after red 02a8deab0b00. Same resource lease, frozen tests, command and environment.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
